Join us at DT

You'll help shape the future of mobile on a global scale – connecting every brand and app to the right mobile user, anywhere.

What’s It Like to Work at DT?

We work hard, but also take time to enjoy the journey, and have fun while doing it
Everyone’s empowered to work their way, global mindsets & diverse perspectives are celebrated
It’s fast-paced, but everyone’s down to earth and supportive

From Our Team

Leadership That Supports & Empowers

I’ve always had great support in my role, thanks to our understanding leaders. My managers are always there to listen to new ideas, help solve problems, and clear any roadblocks. Being able to talk openly with them about any issues is truly remarkable. It’s quite different from traditional hierarchies in other companies.

Abhilash, Associate Creative Director
|
Mumbai, India

In It Together

The meaning of hustle is near and dear to every person here. We all put in the work needed to drive the company forward. I believe sharing equity and similar values help achieve our goals. I have felt appreciated, trusted, and valued as a part of the team.

Kayla, Program Manager
|
Durham, NC

Why join DT

Here, you'll drive meaningful change, develop your strengths, and have the support to make a real impact.

Purpose

Make an impact that matters. Your work at DT drives real change, on a global scale.

Connection

Thrive together. Connection isn’t just a perk, it’s how we succeed.

Comprehensive Coverage

Full medical, dental and vision coverage is provided as well as insurance on group, life, dependent and business travel.

Ownership

Own your path. You’re trusted to lead, take initiative, and shape your own success.

Integrity

Do what’s right. We always aim to do what's right, for our people and our business.

Time Together

From tacos on Mondays to beer on Fridays, we love getting together over good food. Each site has its own locally-inspired perks to keep our teams connected and having fun.

Ready to make a difference?

Join our team and help deliver on our mission to create new paths to discover and connect in the mobile ecosystem
